verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an API-first service: it authenticates with API tokens (docs-35), supports background async operations via the `Prefer: respond-async` header (docs-34), and ships API clients (docs-10). Its docs also recommend isolated per-test namespaces for testing (docs-37), so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts and CI. missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/automation integration guides, programmatic token creation (docs show tokens managed only in the dashboard), a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
